The '''ambush on ''Hashim''''' was a battle that concluded the [[T/D Technology]] campaign.

==Prelude==
After his betrayal of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Battle of Imperial Center|failed]] coup de'tat against [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the treacherous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] continued to wage war against the Empire through an extensive campaign aimed at stripping the Empire of its technological advantage on the battlefield. After successfully, although costly, [[Strategic Warfare|destroying]] the [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|factories]], he set his sights on his [[Research]] station where he developed the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]]. After [[Capture of Research|failing]] to take the platform, [[Defense of Research|twice]], he took it upon himself to [[Evacuation of Research|destroy]] the platform.

However, Loyalist Imperial forces lead by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], held of his attacks until the TIE Defender prototypes [[Proto 11]] and [[Proto 12|12]] were on board a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] [[Mharsup]] and the personnel, which included the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief scientist]] of the project, onto a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] [[G'nabgib]]. The two ships then arrived [[Navigation buoy/Legends|Buoy]] [[B-F09]] to transfer the fighters to [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvette]] group [[Hashim group|''Hashim'']]. Despite [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Second battle of Parmel|interference]], all 3 Defenders were put in a corvette each and left the area. They soon came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] near [[Navigation buoy/Legends|buoy]] [[CRM-114]], to find themselves trapped in a [[Ion mine/Legends|Ion mine]] field laid by [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and were unable to escape on their own, as they were they were outnumbered by multiple [[R-41 Starchaser]]s and a [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Intombe]]''. They called for reinforcements but feared that they may not arrive in time.

==The battle==
===First phase===
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in his TIE Defender was launched to defend the ships. But as soon as he was launched, one of the pirate [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]] from group [[Ibutho group|Ibutho]], [[Ibutho 1]] had already docked with the ''G'nabgib'' and left taking the Chief scientist with them. Stele focused his attention against the other transports as the threat of being captured could at least be thwarted, all the while dogfighting and dodging [[R-41 Starchaser]] squadrons, [[Dhlovo Squadron|Dhlovo]], [[Eshowe Squadron|Eshowe]], [[Gingin Squadron|Gingin]], [[Hlobane Squadron|Hlobane]] and [[Khambula Squadron]], soon into the battle [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] arrived and assisted Stele in eliminating the starfighters and Ion Mines as the Strike Cruiser ''Intombe'' soon departed from the battle.

Although the Pirates were driven of, the corvettes were stranded until help arrives. Also the Chief scientist along with the data were now in the Rneekiii's possession. While it would be possible for the pirates to create a ''TIE Defender'' out of the data and the scientist, it would still take time. Time that could be used to develop a "crash program". The prototypes were still safe from falling into rogue arms, for now.

===Second phase===
Calling for reinforcements, 3 [[Cargo ferry|Cargo Ferries]] [[Mssan]] were brought in to repair the corvettes and transfer the TIE Defenders to each one, with Maarek Stele ordered to dock with ''Masan 3''. However two of them arrived 24 [[Kilometer/Legends|klicks]] away and a Rebel starfighter strike force, consisting of 2 [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], [[Azul Squadron]], 2 [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] and 4 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[Red Squadron]] had just arrived, at a relatively long distance of about 20 Klicks but were still a danger to the ships.

Maarek Stele, was sent in his TIE Defender, again, to intercept the attacking ships. Mssan 3 with two other Assault Gunboats arrived to assist in the attack. However, another pirate force, known as the [[Nami]], arrived in the form of [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 freighter]] ''[[Dhoora]]'' escorted by two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Boegis Squadron]] and two [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from [[Talon Squadron (Nami)|Talon Squadron]] arrived very close to the corvettes and disabled them. ''Dhoora'' proceeded to dock with ''Hashim 1'' and programmed the ship to jump into hyperspace with them. Stele tried to intervene, but only managed to shoot down at least one of the starfighters before the rest escaped.

To make matters even more complicated TIE Defenders under the command of Zaarin arrived to engage Maarek Stele and the Gunboats. Stele managed to destroy all 12 Defenders, while the Cargo ferries arrived to receive the other prototype and Maarek Stele's TIE Defender. Stele was on his way to the Cargo ferries when the Rneekii Pirates once again arrived in a [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari light cruiser]] ''[[Sumpntodo]]'' launching, one by one, [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] [[Adam Squadron]]. Stele engaged the Rneekii Pirates and after destroying some of the fighters, ''Mssan 2'' boarded with ''Hashim 2'', picked up the prototype and jumped into Hyperspace to rendezvous with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Stele was encouraged to do the same and entered ''Masan 3'' to rendezvous with Thrawn.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I have studied Zaarin's ways and have discovered a weakness in his reliance on technology. When our newest starfighter is completed, our forces will strip Zaarin of his technological advantage!|Grand Admiral Thrawn|audio=Thr02-TFCD.flac|<ref name="TF:DE" />}}
The two TIE Defenders arrived to Thrawn's [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star-Destroyer]] safely and Thrawn ordered the ship to return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], therefore allowing the Empire the possibility to manufacture TIE Defenders. However, the situation was still looking very precarious for the Empire, as two pirate factions had important components needed to make their own independent TIE Defenders, the ''Rneekii'' had the Chief scientist and the data needed to construct one, and the ''Nami'' had the other prototype. To combat this, Thrawn began designs for a [[Missile Boat|new starfighter]] to combat this unpredictable threat.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in ''[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire]]'', the expansion to [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in Battle 9, Combats 5 and 6. This article assumes completion of all "Primary", "Secondary" and "Bonus" objectives completed in the game.

It is possible to destroy the ''Dhoora'' before it docks, thereby preventing the capture. However, doing so will result in Zaarin's TIE Defenders and the Rneekii pirate cruiser not turning up, making completion of "Secondary" and "Bonus" objectives impossible. The player can still complete "Primary" mission objectives and return with "mission success".
